sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的新作，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The east side city of Wollongong is located 82 kilometres south of Sydney, in the Illawarra region on the east coast of Australia.
sentences.zh: 伍伦贡市位于悉尼以南82公里处，坐落在澳大利亚东海岸的伊拉瓦拉地区。

sentences.en: With a population of close to 300,000 people, it's the third largest city in the state of New South Wales, behind Sydney and Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 该市人口近30万，是新南威尔士州继悉尼和纽卡斯尔之后的第三大城市。

sentences.en: Archaeological evidence suggests that Indigenous Australians inhabited Wollongong and its rich surrounding regions as far back as 40,000 years.
sentences.zh: 考古证据表明，澳大利亚原住民早在4万年前就开始在伍伦贡及其周边富饶的地区居住。

sentences.en: With the immense growth of Sydney during the early 1800s, new townships were established to expand the population and grow industry.
sentences.zh: 随着19世纪初悉尼的飞速发展，新的城镇相继建立，以扩大人口并发展工业。

sentences.en: A harbour was built in Wollongong, creating a fishing industry, and the Port Kembla Steelworks followed soon after,
sentences.zh: 伍伦贡修建了港口，带动了渔业的发展，随后肯布拉港钢铁厂也应运而生，

sentences.en: cementing Wollongong as a hub of steel and other heavy industries, bricks, fertilisers, machinery, and coal mining.
sentences.zh: 这使伍伦贡成为了钢铁及其他重工业、砖块、化肥、机械和煤矿开采的中心。

sentences.en: The opportunities for working immigrants seemed endless, and soon Wollongong's population grew.
sentences.zh: 对于外来务工人员来说，这里的机会似乎无穷无尽，伍伦贡的人口也随之增长。

sentences.en: By 1966, almost 60% of the workers were immigrants, coming from around 70 countries.
sentences.zh: 到1966年，近60%的工人是来自约70个国家的移民。

sentences.en: The mix of cultures brought a liveliness to the city, which blended with the relaxed atmosphere of leisurely beachside living.
sentences.zh: 多元文化的融合为这座城市带来了活力，并与悠闲的海滨生活氛围交织在一起。

sentences.en: At sea level, surf beaches stretched endlessly both north and south, with twisting rocky coves and crystal clear waters.
sentences.zh: 在海平面上，冲浪海滩向南北两端无尽延伸，伴随着蜿蜒的岩石海湾和清澈见底的海水。

sentences.en: Behind the city, the Illawarra Ranges, also known as the Illawarra Escarpment, fold over and over dramatically along the entire coastline.
sentences.zh: 在城市后方，伊拉瓦拉山脉（又称伊拉瓦拉悬崖）沿着整个海岸线戏剧性地层叠起伏。

sentences.en: Huge cliffs and plateaus eroded over 30 million years are covered in dense, deep green scrub and rainforest, creating a green mountain range hugging the city.
sentences.zh: 巨大的悬崖和高原经过3000万年的侵蚀，覆盖着茂密深绿的灌木丛和雨林，形成了一道环抱城市的绿色山脉。

sentences.en: With its natural beauty and cultural diversity and opportunity, Wollongong was an appealing place to live.
sentences.zh: 凭借其自然美景、文化多样性和发展机遇，伍伦贡成为了一个极具吸引力的居住地。

sentences.en: 56-year-old Wilhelmina Kruger was dropped off to work shortly after 2am on January 29th, 1966.
sentences.zh: 1966年1月29日凌晨2点刚过，56岁的威廉敏娜·克鲁格被送达工作地点。

sentences.en: It was an early start, but she had grown accustomed to her six-day-a-week, 2.30am to 10.30am cleaning job.
sentences.zh: 虽然时间很早，但她已经习惯了每周工作六天、从凌晨2点半到上午10点半的清洁工作。

sentences.en: Each night, she'd unwind in front of the television before going to bed around 8.30pm.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，她在晚上8点半左右上床睡觉前，都会在电视机前放松一下。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina would wake up five hours later to get ready for work, and in recent times, her partner Stanley had been getting up with her.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜会在五小时后醒来准备上班，最近一段时间，她的伴侣斯坦利也会陪她一起起床。

sentences.en: Stanley had been driving Wilhelmina to work from their home in Gwynville, an inner-city suburb of Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利一直负责开车送威廉敏娜去上班，他们住在伍伦贡市中心的内城区格温维尔。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina worked at the Piccadilly Centre, a small indoor shopping arcade, on the corner of Crown Street and Gladstone Avenue, the western edge of Wollongong's city centre.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜在皮卡迪利中心工作，这是一个位于皇冠街和格拉德斯通大道交汇处的小型室内购物中心，处于伍伦贡市中心的西侧边缘。

sentences.en: The Piccadilly Centre is spread out over five floors and is still similar in layout today as it was in 1966.
sentences.zh: 皮卡迪利中心共有五层，其布局至今仍与1966年时大致相同。

sentences.en: The very top level features the Piccadilly Motel, a budget motel that has a reputation of attracting some unruly visitors.
sentences.zh: 最顶层是皮卡迪利汽车旅馆，这是一家以吸引一些不守规矩的访客而闻名的经济型旅馆。

sentences.en: The motel is only accessible by entering the centre via the western entrance on Gladstone Avenue and driving up the external ramp.
sentences.zh: 进入该旅馆的唯一方式是经由格拉德斯通大道的西入口进入中心，并沿外部坡道开车上去。

sentences.en: There is no access to the motel internally.
sentences.zh: 旅馆内部没有通道可达。

sentences.en: Underneath the motel are two floors dedicated to retail, the shopping arcade.
sentences.zh: 旅馆下方有两层专门用于零售，即购物商场。

sentences.en: In the 60s, it featured a variety of department stores, offices and specialty shops that serviced the surrounding community.
sentences.zh: 在60年代，这里汇集了各种百货商店、办公室和专门店，为周边社区提供服务。

sentences.en: The top level of the shopping arcade features pedestrian access only, through the front entrance on Crown Street.
sentences.zh: 购物商场的顶层仅供行人通行，需通过皇冠街的正门进入。

sentences.en: The bottom level of the shopping arcade is accessible from the Gladstone Avenue entrance.
sentences.zh: 购物商场的底层可从格拉德斯通大道入口进入。

sentences.en: And of course, both floors are accessible internally via stairs and escalators.
sentences.zh: 当然，两层楼之间可以通过内部的楼梯和自动扶梯往来。

sentences.en: The bottom level of the shopping arcade also features a car parking area.
sentences.zh: 购物商场的底层还设有一个停车场。

sentences.en: And the two floors underneath, the basement and sub-basement levels, are dedicated entirely to car parking.
sentences.zh: 下方的两层，即地下室和地下二层，则完全用于停车。

sentences.en: Vehicles enter the Piccadilly Centre via the Gladstone Avenue entrance
sentences.zh: 车辆经由格拉德斯通大道入口进入皮卡迪利中心，

sentences.en: and can either park on the Gladstone Avenue level or drive down the ramps to the basement and sub-basement levels.
sentences.zh: 既可以停在格拉德斯通大道这一层，也可以沿坡道开往地下室和地下二层。

sentences.en: Alternatively, you can drive up the ramp to make your way to the motel.
sentences.zh: 或者，你也可以沿坡道向上行驶前往汽车旅馆。

sentences.en: So on that morning, January 29th, 1966,
sentences.zh: 所以，在1966年1月29日那个早晨，

sentences.en: Stanley drove Wilhelmina into the Piccadilly Centre via the Gladstone Avenue entrance.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利开车送威廉敏娜经由格拉德斯通大道入口进入皮卡迪利中心。

sentences.en: They arrived around 2.20am.
sentences.zh: 他们大约在凌晨2点20分到达。

sentences.en: The centre was completely dark.
sentences.zh: 中心里一片漆黑。

sentences.en: It was Wilhelmina's job to turn the lights on.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的工作就是负责开灯。

sentences.en: The ceiling lights on the Gladstone Avenue parking level only dimly lit small areas of the large empty space.
sentences.zh: 格拉德斯通大道停车层的吸顶灯只能微弱地照亮这片巨大空旷区域的一小部分。

sentences.en: But that was better than the basement and sub-basement levels that had no lighting at all.
sentences.zh: 但这总比完全没有照明的地下室和地下二层要好。

sentences.en: The building supervisor refused to install lights down on those levels, as he believed hoodlums would damage them.
sentences.zh: 大楼主管拒绝在那些楼层安装灯具，因为他认为会有流氓破坏它们。

sentences.en: That morning, Wilhelmina was especially anxious.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，威廉敏娜感到格外焦虑。

sentences.en: In the preceding weeks, she had developed a funny feeling that someone was watching her.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，她产生了一种奇怪的感觉，觉得有人在监视她。

sentences.en: It's the reason why Stanley was driving her to work.
sentences.zh: 这就是斯坦利开车送她上班的原因。

sentences.en: And only two days earlier, she had trouble with the lights.
sentences.zh: 而且就在两天前，灯光还出了问题。

sentences.en: When she arrived at work in the early hours of the morning on January 27th,
sentences.zh: 当她在1月27日凌晨到达工作地点时，

sentences.en: the lights didn't turn on at all.
sentences.zh: 灯根本打不开。

sentences.en: Uneasy about working alone in the dark,
sentences.zh: 因为担心独自在黑暗中工作，

sentences.en: Wilhelmina complained to the building supervisor and requested they be repaired.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜向大楼主管投诉并要求维修。

sentences.en: He assured her that he'd get round to it.
sentences.zh: 他向她保证会抽空处理。

sentences.en: However, the next morning, January 28th, the lights still weren't working.
sentences.zh: 然而，第二天早上，即1月28日，灯还是没修好。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina complained again, but this time threatened that if the lights weren't fixed immediately, she wouldn't be attending work the following day.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜再次投诉，但这次她威胁说，如果灯不立即修好，她第二天就不会来上班了。

sentences.en: It was her third year working as a cleaner in the Piccadilly Centre, and Wilhelmina had established herself as a valued and highly respected hard worker.
sentences.zh: 这是她在皮卡迪利中心做清洁工的第三个年头，威廉敏娜一直以勤恳、受人尊敬的优秀员工形象著称。

sentences.en: She wasn't a petty complainer.
sentences.zh: 她不是那种爱抱怨琐事的人。

sentences.en: It was clear the broken lights were making her uncomfortable, so the building supervisor called an electrician in to fix them.
sentences.zh: 很明显，坏掉的灯让她感到不安，于是大楼主管叫来了一名电工进行修理。

sentences.en: The cause of the problem was found in the wooden fuse box in the parking area on the Gladstone Avenue level.
sentences.zh: 问题的根源在格拉德斯通大道停车区的木制保险丝盒里。

sentences.en: The lights had fused.
sentences.zh: 保险丝烧断了。

sentences.en: It was an easy fix, not a big problem at all, and it could have been caused by a multitude of issues.
sentences.zh: 这很容易修复，根本不是什么大问题，而且可能是由多种原因造成的。

sentences.en: But one of the screws in the lock-hasp of the fuse box door was hanging out, which made it look like someone had accessed it without a key.
sentences.zh: 但保险丝盒门锁扣上的一颗螺丝悬在外面，这看起来就像有人没用钥匙就打开过它。

sentences.en: The electrician replaced the damaged fuse, and the lights were back working again.
sentences.zh: 电工更换了损坏的保险丝，灯又恢复了正常。

sentences.en: He tightened the loose screw back into place and reported his findings to the building supervisor.
sentences.zh: 他把松动的螺丝拧回原位，并向大楼主管报告了他的发现。

sentences.en: The supervisor nodded.
sentences.zh: 主管点了点头。

sentences.en: His assumptions were confirmed.
sentences.zh: 他的猜测得到了证实。

sentences.en: Hoodlums were entering the Piccadilly Centre at night and destroying his property.
sentences.zh: 有流氓在晚上潜入皮卡迪利中心并破坏他的财产。

sentences.en: He told the electrician that only three weeks earlier, he had found two of the three screws in the hasp of the fuse box missing completely.
sentences.zh: 他告诉电工，就在三周前，他发现保险丝盒锁扣上的三颗螺丝中有两颗完全不见了。

sentences.en: The electrician had tended to fix the lights after Wilhelmina had finished her shift,
sentences.zh: 电工通常是在威廉敏娜下班后才去修理灯具的，

sentences.en: so she wasn't sure if they were back working again when she arrived to start her shift on the morning of the 29th.
sentences.zh: 所以她不确定在29日早上开始工作时，灯是否已经修好了。

sentences.en: Stanley parked the car and got out to walk alongside Wilhelmina to the small fuse box on a nearby concrete pillar.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利停好车，下车陪威廉敏娜走到附近混凝土柱上的小保险丝盒旁。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina unlocked the fuse box with her set of keys, and Stanley flicked several switches inside.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜用钥匙打开了保险丝盒，斯坦利拨动了里面的几个开关。

sentences.en: When the lights slowly flickered on in the parking area, both Wilhelmina and Stanley were relieved.
sentences.zh: 当停车区的灯光缓缓亮起时，威廉敏娜和斯坦利都松了一口气。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina went to the second fuse box at the far end of the building that turned on the main lights in the shopping arcade.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜走到大楼另一端的第二个保险丝盒前，那里控制着购物商场的主灯。

sentences.en: On some mornings, Stanley stayed to help Wilhelmina clean, to keep her company, and to help her get through the overwhelming amount of duties she needed to complete in her shift.
sentences.zh: 有时斯坦利会留下来帮威廉敏娜打扫，陪陪她，并帮她完成班次中繁重的工作量。

sentences.en: She had a large area to tend to, not just the two levels of the shopping arcade, but also several shop interiors and the motel foyer on the very top level.
sentences.zh: 她需要负责的区域很大，不仅包括两层购物商场，还有几间商店内部以及最顶层的旅馆门厅。

sentences.en: There was so much work to do that she rarely completed everything by the end of her shift.
sentences.zh: 工作量实在太大，她很少能在下班前完成所有任务。

sentences.en: But that morning, Stanley opted to go back home to bed, as he had to go to work himself that day.
sentences.zh: 但那天早上，斯坦利选择回家睡觉，因为他自己当天也要上班。

sentences.en: He and Wilhelmina exchanged a goodbye wave as he slowly drove out of the centre.
sentences.zh: 他和威廉敏娜挥手告别，随后慢慢开车离开了中心。

sentences.en: By 5.30am, the sun had not yet risen over Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 到了凌晨5点半，伍伦贡的太阳还没有升起。

sentences.en: The outer city streets were dark, empty, and quiet when Thomas Fitzgibbon arrived at the Piccadilly Centre from his home in Dabdo, a south-western suburb of Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 当托马斯·菲茨吉本从位于伍伦贡西南郊区达布多的家中到达皮卡迪利中心时，外面的街道黑暗、空旷且寂静。

sentences.en: Thomas was a butcher and was working inside the Piccadilly Centre that morning.
sentences.zh: 托马斯是一名屠夫，那天早上在皮卡迪利中心内工作。

sentences.en: Due to start work at 6am,
sentences.zh: 他本应在早上6点开始工作，

sentences.en: Thomas pulled into Railway Square, a short roadway adjacent to Wollongong train station, directly behind the Piccadilly Centre.
sentences.zh: 托马斯把车开进了铁路广场，这是一条紧邻伍伦贡火车站、位于皮卡迪利中心正后方的短路。

sentences.en: He parked his car and began the short walk to work.
sentences.zh: 他停好车，开始步行前往工作地点。

sentences.en: He made his way up a footpath on the eastern side of the Piccadilly Centre that ran between the centre and the train line.
sentences.zh: 他沿着皮卡迪利中心东侧的一条人行道走去，那条路位于中心和铁路线之间。

sentences.en: This took him to Crown Street, where he bought a newspaper, and then entered the shopping arcade area through the front entrance on Crown Street.
sentences.zh: 他由此走到皇冠街，买了一份报纸，然后从皇冠街的正门进入购物商场区域。

sentences.en: It came as no surprise that the centre was deserted when Thomas entered.
sentences.zh: 托马斯进入中心时，里面空无一人，这并不奇怪。

sentences.en: But what was surprising was that the air inside felt unusually heavy and hot.
sentences.zh: 但令人惊讶的是，里面的空气感觉异常沉闷且燥热。

sentences.en: He investigated and found an electric immersion heater submerged in a drum of water at the rear of the building.
sentences.zh: 他进行查看，发现大楼后部的一个水桶里浸着一个电加热器。

sentences.en: The heater had caused the water to boil, filling the arcade with steam.
sentences.zh: 加热器导致水沸腾，整个商场里充满了蒸汽。

sentences.en: He knew the drum and heater were items used by the cleaner, and there was little water remaining, so it looked like it had been left for some time.
sentences.zh: 他知道那个桶和加热器是清洁工用的工具，而且桶里剩下的水不多了，看起来已经放了有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Thomas didn't touch the drum or heater, and instead headed to the butcher shop.
sentences.zh: 托马斯没有碰那个桶或加热器，而是直接走向肉铺。

sentences.en: When he attempted to open the door, it was locked.
sentences.zh: 当他试图开门时，门锁着。

sentences.en: The owner hadn't arrived yet.
sentences.zh: 店主还没到。

sentences.en: While standing around waiting,
sentences.zh: 在等待的时候，

sentences.en: Thomas realised he'd left his butchering knives back in his car, so he had to go back and get them.
sentences.zh: 托马斯意识到他把屠宰刀忘在车里了，所以他不得不回去取。

sentences.en: Excluding the very top level where the motel was, each level of the Piccadilly Centre was accessible by an escalator and staircase located at the back end of the building.
sentences.zh: 除了有旅馆的最顶层外，皮卡迪利中心的每一层都可以通过位于大楼后部的自动扶梯和楼梯到达。

sentences.en: The escalators only accessed the shopping arcade levels, but the staircase continued all the way down to the basement and sub-basement parking levels.
sentences.zh: 自动扶梯只能到达购物商场楼层，但楼梯一直通往地下室和地下二层的停车区。

sentences.en: When Thomas reached the escalator, there was a mop and bucket in the way, and a ring of keys on the ground.
sentences.zh: 当托马斯走到自动扶梯时，路上挡着一个拖把和水桶，地上还有一串钥匙。

sentences.en: The items appeared to have been left lying around haphazardly by the cleaner, who probably didn't expect many people to be walking around at that time of morning.
sentences.zh: 这些物品看起来像是清洁工随手丢在那里的，她可能没想到这么早会有这么多人走动。

sentences.en: Thomas bypassed the escalator and took the stairs instead.
sentences.zh: 托马斯绕过自动扶梯，改走楼梯。

sentences.en: He attempted to open a service door, but it was jammed, probably locked, so he decided to continue down to the very bottom sub-basement level
sentences.zh: 他试图打开一扇服务门，但门卡住了，可能锁上了，于是他决定继续往下走到最底层的地下二层，

sentences.en: where he would be able to walk straight out to his car.
sentences.zh: 在那里他可以直接走到自己的车旁。

sentences.en: His attention was drawn to a men's wristwatch near the top of the stairs.
sentences.zh: 他的注意力被楼梯顶部附近的一块男士手表吸引了。

sentences.en: Someone must have lost it, he assumed.
sentences.zh: 他心想，肯定是有人把它弄丢了。

sentences.en: He left it and continued down the stairs where he stepped over a bunched-up cleaner's apron.
sentences.zh: 他没管它，继续走下楼梯，跨过了一件揉成一团的清洁工围裙。

sentences.en: As he descended down to the sub-basement level, dawn was now breaking and a faint morning light was seeping through.
sentences.zh: 当他下到地下二层时，黎明已经破晓，微弱的晨光透了进来。

sentences.en: His eyes adjusted to the dark, shadowy space below.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛适应了下方黑暗阴影的空间。

sentences.en: He tensed when he saw the outline of a person lying on the ground at the foot of the stairs.
sentences.zh: 当他看到楼梯底部地上躺着一个人影时，他紧张了起来。

sentences.en: He rushed back up the stairs to find a telephone.
sentences.zh: 他冲回楼梯上面去寻找电话。

sentences.en: Unable to find one, he sprinted out onto the street and approached a taxi who had just dropped a passenger off at the Piccadilly Centre.
sentences.zh: 没找到电话，他冲到街上，拦住了一辆刚在皮卡迪利中心放下乘客的出租车。

sentences.en: Thomas yelled at the driver to radio for an ambulance as there had been an accident.
sentences.zh: 托马斯冲司机大喊，让他用无线电呼叫救护车，因为发生了事故。

sentences.en: It was approximately 5.45am.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是凌晨5点45分。

sentences.en: Thomas rushed back down to the sub-basement level to render assistance.
sentences.zh: 托马斯冲回地下二层进行救助。

sentences.en: As he approached the foot of the stairs where the person lay,
sentences.zh: 当他靠近那个人躺着的楼梯底部时，

sentences.en: he physically recoiled.
sentences.zh: 他本能地退缩了。

sentences.en: There was blood everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是血。

sentences.en: Investigators knew the moment they arrived on the scene that this was one of, if not the most brutal murders in the history of New South Wales.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在到达现场的那一刻就知道，这是新南威尔士州历史上最残忍的谋杀案之一，甚至可能就是最残忍的一起。

sentences.en: One and a half pages of notes were required to detail the horrific injuries inflicted on the female victim, who was identified as 56-year-old Piccadilly Centre employee,
sentences.zh: 需要一页半的笔记才能详细记录下受害女性所遭受的恐怖伤害，她被确认为56岁的皮卡迪利中心员工，

sentences.en: Wilhelmina Kruger.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜·克鲁格。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina was found on her back, partially covered by a dress and petticoat, both of which were badly torn and bloodstained.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜被发现时仰面躺着，身上部分覆盖着一件连衣裙和衬裙，两者都已严重撕裂并沾满血迹。

sentences.en: She was naked from the chest down.
sentences.zh: 她从胸部以下赤身裸体。

sentences.en: Her eyes were bruised black.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛被打得青紫。

sentences.en: Her nose, jaw and five of her ribs were broken.
sentences.zh: 她的鼻子、下巴和五根肋骨骨折。

sentences.en: She had suffered multiple stab wounds all over her face, head, neck and body.
sentences.zh: 她的脸部、头部、颈部和身体各处遭受了多处刺伤。

sentences.en: Her heart had been ruptured.
sentences.zh: 她的心脏破裂。

sentences.en: Her skin was bruised, bitten and torn.
sentences.zh: 她的皮肤上有淤青、咬痕和撕裂伤。

sentences.en: Breasts disfigured.
sentences.zh: 乳房被毁容。

sentences.en: Disembowelment had occurred and a cord was secured tied around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她被开膛破肚，脖子上还紧紧缠着一根绳子。

sentences.en: The trail of objects leading from the crime scene up into the shopping arcade gave a detailed account of what happened.
sentences.zh: 从犯罪现场一直延伸到购物商场的物品踪迹，详细记录了所发生的一切。

sentences.en: The drum of water and submerged heater, along with the mop and bucket at the top of the escalators, showed that Wilhelmina was in the process of mopping when she was attacked.
sentences.zh: 水桶和浸没的加热器，以及自动扶梯顶部的拖把和水桶，表明威廉敏娜在遭到袭击时正在拖地。

sentences.en: As she dunked the mop into the bucket, her killer snuck up behind her and wrapped a cord around her neck.
sentences.zh: 当她把拖把浸入桶中时，凶手从她身后潜入，用绳子勒住了她的脖子。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina put up a fight.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜进行了反抗。

sentences.en: She struggled with her attacker as she was dragged down the escalator.
sentences.zh: 在被拖下自动扶梯时，她与袭击者发生了搏斗。

sentences.en: Several cuts and scrapes on her body were attributed to the rigid edges of the escalator steps.
sentences.zh: 她身上的一些割伤和擦伤被认为是自动扶梯台阶的坚硬边缘造成的。

sentences.en: On the escalator, she lost her keys, the top set of her false teeth and a shoe.
sentences.zh: 在自动扶梯上，她弄丢了钥匙、上排假牙和一只鞋子。

sentences.en: At the stairs leading down to the parking levels, the struggle intensified.
sentences.zh: 在通往停车层的楼梯处，搏斗变得更加激烈。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina wore a men's wristwatch and it unclipped from her wriSt.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜戴着一块男士手表，它从她的手腕上脱落了。

sentences.en: Her apron was ripped off on the stairs and the vicious mutilation began on the sub-basement parking level.
sentences.zh: 她的围裙在楼梯上被扯掉，随后在地下二层停车区开始了残忍的肢解。

sentences.en: The killing appeared premeditated.
sentences.zh: 这起杀人案似乎是蓄谋已久的。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina's attacker showed he was familiar with the layout of the Piccadilly Centre, intentionally dragging her down to the dark sub-basement level where they wouldn't be seen.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的袭击者表现出对皮卡迪利中心的布局非常熟悉，他故意将她拖到黑暗的地下二层，那里不会被人看见。

sentences.en: Additionally, the killer was aware
sentences.zh: 此外，凶手知道

sentences.en: Wilhelmina would be working there alone.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜会独自在那里工作。

sentences.en: The killer may have watched her for some time, familiarising himself with her routine and determining the ideal time to strike.
sentences.zh: 凶手可能已经观察了她一段时间，熟悉了她的作息规律，并确定了最佳的下手时机。

sentences.en: It was well known Wilhelmina worked meticulously and methodically to a predictable set routine that rarely changed.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，威廉敏娜工作细致且有条不紊，遵循着一套几乎从不改变的可预测的日常程序。

sentences.en: She completed her duties in the same order at around the same time each morning, so it was known that Wilhelmina began cleaning the post office around 4.40am.
sentences.zh: 她每天早上都在大致相同的时间按同样的顺序完成工作，因此大家都知道威廉敏娜（Wilhelmina）通常在凌晨4点40分左右开始打扫邮局。

sentences.en: However, the post office hadn't yet been cleaned, which meant the time of her murder was likely prior to 4.40am.
sentences.zh: 然而，邮局当时尚未打扫，这意味着她遇害的时间很可能在凌晨4点40分之前。

sentences.en: Several unknown fingerprints were discovered at the crime scene, along with a large bloody footprint the size of an average man's shoe.
sentences.zh: 案发现场发现了几个身份不明的指纹，以及一个巨大的血脚印，大小与普通男性的鞋子相当。

sentences.en: The same footprint was found at the top of the stairs, leading down to the basement and sub-basement parking levels.
sentences.zh: 在楼梯顶部也发现了同样的脚印，一直延伸到地下室和地下停车层。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina didn't smoke, but 30 centimetres away from her body were two cigarette butts.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜不抽烟，但距离她尸体30厘米处有两个烟头。

sentences.en: The front of her dress also had seven circular holes caused by the tip of a burning cigarette.
sentences.zh: 她裙子的前襟还有七个圆孔，是由燃烧的烟头尖端造成的。

sentences.en: The murder weapon was believed to be a 15 centimetre long,
sentences.zh: 据信凶器是一把长15厘米、

sentences.en: 3 centimetre wide, double-edged knife.
sentences.zh: 宽3厘米的双刃刀。

sentences.en: It wasn't found at the scene.
sentences.zh: 现场并未找到这把刀。

sentences.en: A police officer conducting an initial search of the Piccadilly Centre noticed a bunch of ripped-out hair on the steps of the escalator.
sentences.zh: 一名警察在对皮卡迪利中心（Piccadilly Centre）进行初步搜查时，在自动扶梯的台阶上发现了一撮被扯下的头发。

sentences.en: There were about 30 hairs in the bunch.
sentences.zh: 这撮头发大约有30根。

sentences.en: They were blonde in colour and around 1 to 1.5 inches long.
sentences.zh: 它们呈金色，长约1到1.5英寸。

sentences.en: The hairs had little white particles on the ends, giving the appearance that they had been pulled out by the roots.
sentences.zh: 发梢带有白色小颗粒，看起来像是连根拔起的。

sentences.en: This hair sample didn't match Wilhelmina's.
sentences.zh: 这些头发样本与威廉敏娜的头发不符。

sentences.en: Her natural hair was greying, so she had been dying at a reddish-brown colour.
sentences.zh: 她原本的头发正在变灰，所以她一直染成红棕色。

sentences.en: The officer who discovered the hairs didn't touch or disturb them.
sentences.zh: 发现头发的那名警察没有触碰或扰动它们。

sentences.en: However, investigators weren't alerted until around an hour later, and when they went to collect them, the hair was no longer there,
sentences.zh: 然而，调查人员直到大约一小时后才接到通知，当他们去收集时，头发已经不见了，

sentences.en: presumably blown away by a draught.
sentences.zh: 推测是被穿堂风吹走了。

sentences.en: Similar pieces of hair were stuck to Wilhelmina's right thumb and left index finger.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的右手拇指和左手食指上也粘着类似的头发。

sentences.en: These pieces did not have roots attached.
sentences.zh: 这些头发上没有发根。

sentences.en: The light colouring of the hair sample was thought to be as a result of bleaching.
sentences.zh: 头发样本的浅色被认为是漂白的结果。

sentences.en: The stray hairs on Wilhelmina's fingertips visually matched the bunch of torn hair seen on the escalator, but as those hairs weren't recovered, a match could never be confirmed.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜指尖上的零星头发在视觉上与自动扶梯上看到的那撮被扯下的头发相符，但由于那些头发没能找回，无法证实两者是否匹配。

sentences.en: A one centimetre wound on the left side of Wilhelmina's face was believed to have been caused by a ring on her killer's finger.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜左脸上一道一厘米长的伤口，被认为是由凶手手指上的戒指造成的。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed that
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，

sentences.en: Wilhelmina's cause of death was strangulation.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的死因是勒死。

sentences.en: It was believed that she had died five minutes into the violent attack.
sentences.zh: 据信她在遭受暴力袭击五分钟后死亡。

sentences.en: The stab wounds and mutilation inflicted all over her body occurred after death.
sentences.zh: 她身上遭受的刺伤和毁容是在死后发生的。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》（Case File）稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Every available police officer in Wollongong assisted with the initial investigation into Wilhelmina Kruger's murder.
sentences.zh: 伍伦贡（Wollongong）所有在职警察都协助参与了威廉敏娜·克鲁格（Wilhelmina Kruger）谋杀案的初步调查。

sentences.en: Those on leave had it cancelled and had to return to work.
sentences.zh: 休假的警察被取消了假期，必须返回工作岗位。

sentences.en: The investigation showed that after being dropped off at the Piccadilly Centre by her partner Stanley around 2.20am,
sentences.zh: 调查显示，在凌晨2点20分左右被伴侣斯坦利（Stanley）送到皮卡迪利中心后，

sentences.en: Wilhelmina had gotten straight to work.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜便直接开始工作了。

sentences.en: She worked out of a caretaker's office on the bottom level of the shopping arcade where all the cleaning equipment was stored.
sentences.zh: 她在购物中心底层的一间管理员办公室工作，那里存放着所有的清洁设备。

sentences.en: There were several witnesses who confirmed seeing Wilhelmina working in the arcade that morning.
sentences.zh: 有几位目击者证实那天早上看到威廉敏娜在商场工作。

sentences.en: A police officer happened to be driving his patrol car down Gladstone Avenue at 3.20am.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点20分，一名警察恰好开车巡逻经过格莱斯顿大道（Gladstone Avenue）。

sentences.en: He saw the lights in the parking area on the Gladstone Avenue level were off and thinking that was unusual, the constable pulled into the centre to investigate.
sentences.zh: 他看到格莱斯顿大道一侧停车区的灯是灭的，觉得很不寻常，于是这名警员驶入中心进行调查。

sentences.en: In the darkened space, he saw the outline of a female carrying something.
sentences.zh: 在昏暗的空间里，他看到一个女性的身影，手里拿着东西。

sentences.en: The constable slowly drove up the ramp to the motel.
sentences.zh: 警员缓慢地开车上了通往汽车旅馆的坡道。

sentences.en: He patrolled the motel car park and then drove back down the ramp when he saw the woman again.
sentences.zh: 他巡视了旅馆停车场，然后开车下坡道时又看到了那个女人。

sentences.en: It's believed the woman he saw was Wilhelmina, carrying her mop and bucket.
sentences.zh: 据信他看到的女人就是威廉敏娜，当时她正拿着拖把和水桶。

sentences.en: It was 3.40am when the officer drove away.
sentences.zh: 警察开车离开时是凌晨3点40分。

sentences.en: Separately, a car carrying a male driver, his wife, and four of their friends drove east along Crown Street around 3.30am that morning.
sentences.zh: 另外，当天凌晨3点30分左右，一辆载着一名男司机、他妻子以及四位朋友的车沿皇冠街（Crown Street）向东行驶。

sentences.en: As they passed the Piccadilly Centre, the driver spotted Wilhelmina mopping the entrance of the shopping arcade.
sentences.zh: 当他们经过皮卡迪利中心时，司机发现威廉敏娜正在拖洗购物中心的入口。

sentences.en: He commented to the others in the car,
sentences.zh: 他对车里的其他人评论道：

sentences.en: Imagine having to be up cleaning at this hour.
sentences.zh: “想象一下，在这个点还得起来打扫卫生。”

sentences.en: The group drove further down Crown Street until it merged into Keira Street.
sentences.zh: 这群人沿着皇冠街继续行驶，直到汇入凯拉街（Keira Street）。

sentences.en: The group had travelled all the way from the southern state of Victoria, so decided they should find somewhere to stop and reSt.
sentences.zh: 他们一路从南部的维多利亚州赶来，所以决定找个地方停下来休息。

sentences.en: They spotted a man sitting in the driver's seat of a utility vehicle parked on the side of Keira Street.
sentences.zh: 他们发现一个男人坐在停在凯拉街路边的一辆多功能车驾驶座上。

sentences.en: They asked him if there was somewhere nearby they could get a bed for the night.
sentences.zh: 他们问他附近有没有可以过夜的地方。

sentences.en: The man directed them back up Crown Street to the Piccadilly Motel.
sentences.zh: 那人指引他们沿皇冠街返回皮卡迪利汽车旅馆。

sentences.en: As they drove up the ramp to the motel lobby, they spotted Wilhelmina again.
sentences.zh: 当他们开车上坡道前往旅馆大堂时，他们又看到了威廉敏娜。

sentences.en: It was around 3.58am.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是凌晨3点58分。

sentences.en: She was alone and carrying a mop and bucket towards the escalators.
sentences.zh: 她独自一人，正拿着拖把和水桶朝自动扶梯走去。

sentences.en: The group booked into the motel and later, they heard, quote, a tremendous noise like a vehicle driven fast and turning at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这群人办理了入住手续，后来他们听到“一声巨大的噪音，就像车辆快速行驶并同时转弯的声音”。

sentences.en: The Piccadilly Centre's night watchman actually spoke to Wilhelmina.
sentences.zh: 皮卡迪利中心的夜班保安确实和威廉敏娜说过话。

sentences.en: At around 4am, the two bumped into each other in the shopping arcade.
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点左右，两人在购物中心碰面了。

sentences.en: He said g'day to Wilhelmina, who he called Amy, and gave her a copy of the morning newspaper.
sentences.zh: 他向威廉敏娜（他称她为艾米）问好，并给了她一份晨报。

sentences.en: During their brief exchange,
sentences.zh: 在他们简短的交谈中，

sentences.en: Wilhelmina emptied her bucket into the gutter at the front
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜把水桶里的水倒进了商场前门

sentences.en: Crown Street entrance of the arcade.
sentences.zh: 皇冠街入口处的排水沟里。

sentences.en: The two then went their separate ways and the night watchman didn't see or hear
sentences.zh: 随后两人分道扬镳，夜班保安此后就再也没有见过或听到过

sentences.en: Wilhelmina for the remainder of the morning.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的消息。

sentences.en: These statements greatly narrowed down the time of the murder.
sentences.zh: 这些证词极大地缩小了谋杀发生的时间范围。

sentences.en: It occurred sometime after this final interaction with the night watchman at 4am and prior to her scheduled post office clean at 4.40am.
sentences.zh: 它发生在凌晨4点与夜班保安最后一次互动之后，以及她预定在凌晨4点40分打扫邮局之前。

sentences.en: The building supervisor was interviewed by police.
sentences.zh: 警方对大楼主管进行了问话。

sentences.en: He outlined the issues he'd been having with the tampered fuse box and gave details of the electrician who had been called to fix the lights only the day before.
sentences.zh: 他概述了保险丝盒被篡改的问题，并提供了前一天被叫来修理灯光的电工的详细信息。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina's partner,
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的伴侣，

sentences.en: Stanley, confirmed the lights were working again when he dropped
sentences.zh: 斯坦利证实，当他在谋杀案发生的当天早上送

sentences.en: Wilhelmina off the morning of her murder.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜过来时，灯还是好的。

sentences.en: However, the lights were off when police investigated the crime scene and the patrolling police officer reported they were off when he conducted his patrol at 3.20am that morning.
sentences.zh: 然而，当警方调查案发现场时灯是灭的，巡逻警察也报告说他在凌晨3点20分巡逻时灯也是灭的。

sentences.en: Investigators checked the fuse box and saw a screw was sticking out of the hasp.
sentences.zh: 调查人员检查了保险丝盒，发现一个螺丝从扣环里突了出来。

sentences.en: Inside the fuse box, two of the fuses had blown, meaning the lights had gone out on Wilhelmina during her shift.
sentences.zh: 保险丝盒内有两个保险丝烧断了，这意味着威廉敏娜在值班期间灯灭了。

sentences.en: Highly unusual considering they had only been fixed the day before.
sentences.zh: 考虑到前一天才刚修好，这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: Markings on the fuse box and the loose screws confirmed it had been tampered with again.
sentences.zh: 保险丝盒上的痕迹和松动的螺丝证实它再次被人动过手脚。

sentences.en: It was starting to look like there was a far more sinister explanation than hoodluMs.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不仅仅是流氓捣乱，背后似乎有更险恶的解释。

sentences.en: If it was
sentences.zh: 如果

sentences.en: Wilhelmina's killer who accessed the fuse box and turned off the lights, at least three weeks of planning and stalking had gone into the murder, as that's when signs of tampering
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜的凶手进入保险丝盒并关掉了灯，那么这起谋杀案至少经过了三周的策划和跟踪，因为那时就出现了被篡改的迹象。

sentences.en: first appeared.
sentences.zh: 最初出现。

sentences.en: Shortly after arriving at the crime scene, investigators were hit with a bizarre distraction.

sentences.zh: 她的儿子和前夫住在一起，她已经很久没见过他了。

sentences.en: Anna's personal life was so widely scattered throughout Australia, and so disjointed from the deception of aliases and false identities, it was difficult for investigators to piece
sentences.zh: 安娜的个人生活在澳大利亚各地四分五裂，又因化名和虚假身份的欺骗而支离破碎，调查人员很难在

sentences.en: together her history prior to her murder.
sentences.zh: 她遇害前拼凑出她的历史。

sentences.en: Associates and clients in the sex industry who knew Anna were not very forthcoming with information.
sentences.zh: 认识安娜的性行业同僚和客户并不愿意提供信息。

sentences.en: The only confirmed fact was that Anna was last seen alive by her friends as she left the taxi club in Darlinghurst, ten days before her body was found.
sentences.zh: 唯一确认的事实是，安娜最后一次被朋友看到活着是在她离开达令赫斯特的出租车俱乐部时，那是她尸体被发现的十天前。

sentences.en: No one recalled seeing her outside the club, leading investigators to believe she may have met her killer immediately after walking outside, possibly stepping into
sentences.zh: 没有人记得在俱乐部外见过她，这让调查人员认为她可能在走出俱乐部后立即遇到了凶手，甚至可能直接上了

sentences.en: the killer's vehicle.
sentences.zh: 凶手的车。

sentences.en: The remainder of Anna's belongings she had with her that night, including her cardigan, brooch, shoes, stockings, and handbag with two diaries inside, were missing.
sentences.zh: 安娜当晚随身携带的其他物品，包括她的开衫、胸针、鞋子、长筒袜以及装有两本日记的手提包，都不见了。

sentences.en: The most disturbing discovery made at the crime scene were ten metres of drag marks on the ground leading out from a thicket of bushes to where Anna's body was found.
sentences.zh: 现场最令人不安的发现是地上有十米长的拖拽痕迹，从一片灌木丛一直延伸到安娜尸体被发现的地方。

sentences.en: A crime scene examination revealed that the killer had originally dumped Anna's body in the bushes, but the bushes prevented her from being found, and the killer grew impatient.
sentences.zh: 现场勘查显示，凶手最初将安娜的尸体丢弃在灌木丛中，但灌木丛掩盖了尸体，导致没被发现，凶手变得不耐烦了。

sentences.en: So he returned to the scene three to four days later and dragged Anna's body out of the concealment of the bushes to the open spot on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 于是他在三四天后回到现场，将安娜的尸体从灌木丛中拖出，扔到了路边显眼的地方。

sentences.en: The killer wanted Anna to be found.
sentences.zh: 凶手希望安娜被发现。

sentences.en: Psychiatrists consulted by police explained that this action was common with killers who found pleasure in the infamy of their acts.
sentences.zh: 警方咨询的精神病学家解释说，这种行为在那些以自己的恶行出名为乐的凶手中很常见。

sentences.en: There were unusual acts performed after both murders that, if done by the same killer, proved he was a gruesome showman who derived pleasure taunting police.
sentences.zh: 两起谋杀案后都发生了不同寻常的行为，如果出自同一凶手之手，证明他是一个令人毛骨悚然的表演者，以戏弄警方为乐。

sentences.en: There was the bomb hoax at the Piccadilly
sentences.zh: 比如皮卡迪利中心的炸弹恶作剧，

sentences.en: Centre, the suspicious statements of the unknown witness who called himself Gary
sentences.zh: 自称加里·芒洛的未知证人的可疑陈述，

sentences.en: Mumlow, and now the intentional interference of Anna's body to ensure it would be discovered.
sentences.zh: 以及现在故意干扰安娜的尸体以确保其被发现。

sentences.en: If the same killer was at work, he wasn't burdened with a sense of remorse or guilt, and police knew he would likely strike again.
sentences.zh: 如果确实是同一凶手所为，他毫无悔意或愧疚感，警方知道他很可能会再次作案。

sentences.en: However, they weren't sure if it was the same killer, and just like the murder of
sentences.zh: 然而，他们不确定是否是同一凶手，而且就像威廉敏娜·克鲁格的谋杀案一样，

sentences.en: Wilhelmina Kruger, Anna's murder featured no worthwhile leads, suspects, or motives.
sentences.zh: 安娜的谋杀案也没有任何有价值的线索、嫌疑人或动机。

sentences.en: Police were initially hesitant to publicly draw direct parallels between the two murders.
sentences.zh: 警方起初对公开将两起谋杀案直接联系起来持谨慎态度。

sentences.en: However, behind the scenes, the two investigations worked in tandem.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，两项调查是同步进行的。

sentences.en: Shopkeepers, cafe owners, and hotel and motel managers in Wollongong were questioned about Anna.
sentences.zh: 卧龙岗的店主、咖啡馆老板以及酒店和汽车旅馆经理都受到了关于安娜的询问。

sentences.en: There were rumours she may have spent time in
sentences.zh: 有传言称她曾在某个阶段在卧龙岗待过，

sentences.en: Wollongong at some stage, but with all her different aliases, it was hard to pin down exactly where she had been and whom she had interacted with.
sentences.zh: 但由于她使用了各种化名，很难确定她到底去过哪里，以及与谁有过接触。

sentences.en: Over 1,700 people were interviewed in relation to both murders, and a $10,000 reward was offered for information leading to an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 警方就两起谋杀案采访了超过1700人，并悬赏1万美元征集有助于逮捕凶手的线索。

sentences.en: Despite the offer, no information was shared to help identify the killer.
sentences.zh: 尽管有悬赏，但没有任何信息能帮助查明凶手身份。

sentences.en: Whoever it was, it seemed as though he lived two separate lives.
sentences.zh: 无论他是谁，他似乎过着两种截然不同的生活。

sentences.en: One life as an unassuming member of the community who didn't draw much attention to himself, and the second life, a frenzied psychopathic killer
sentences.zh: 一种生活是社区中谦逊的一员，不引人注意；另一种生活则是疯狂的变态杀手，

sentences.en: who wanted his violent acts to be front-page news.
sentences.zh: 渴望让自己的暴力行径登上头条新闻。

sentences.en: Police worked feverishly in fear another attack was imminent.
sentences.zh: 警方在担心另一起袭击即将发生的情况下疯狂工作。

sentences.en: Almost four months after the murder of Anna Dowling
sentences.zh: 在安娜·道林遇害近四个月后，

sentences.en: Cowher, on the night of June 11, 1966,
20-year-old Carolyn Orphan said goodbye to her parents and left her family home in Gwynnville.
sentences.zh: 20岁的卡罗琳·奥尔芬告别父母，离开了位于格温维尔的家。

sentences.en: Carolyn was known as a quiet and reserved, respectable woman.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳以安静、内向、体面著称。

sentences.en: That night, she'd agreed to go out dancing with friends to let her hair down.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她答应和朋友们出去跳舞，放松一下。

sentences.en: Carolyn and her friends wound up at the Ironworkers
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳和朋友们最终来到了位于卧龙岗皇冠街的钢铁工人俱乐部，

sentences.en: Club on Crown Street, Wollongong, just east of the Piccadilly Centre.
sentences.zh: 就在皮卡迪利中心以东。

sentences.en: Carolyn crossed paths with the cheerful and friendly
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳偶遇了开朗友好的

sentences.en: Alan Bassett, a 20-year-old man from Unandera, a suburb in southwest Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·巴塞特，一名来自卧龙岗西南部郊区尤南德拉的20岁男子。

sentences.en: Bassett worked as a manufacturer and assembler of metal components for tools and machinery.
sentences.zh: 巴塞特是一名工具和机械金属部件的制造和装配工。

sentences.en: He had the natural, rugged charm of an everyday working man, and both he and Carolyn hit it off instantly.
sentences.zh: 他有着普通劳动者那种自然、粗犷的魅力，他和卡罗琳一见如故。

sentences.en: The two enjoyed a dizzying late night of drinking and dancing together.
sentences.zh: 两人度过了一个令人陶醉的深夜，一起喝酒跳舞。

sentences.en: It was nearing midnight when Bassett offered Carolyn a lift home.
sentences.zh: 临近午夜时，巴塞特主动提出开车送卡罗琳回家。

sentences.en: Graciously, she got into the passenger seat of his light-coloured sedan.
sentences.zh: 她客气地坐进了他那辆浅色轿车的副驾驶座。

sentences.en: Bassett assured Carolyn it was no trouble.
sentences.zh: 巴塞特向卡罗琳保证这没问题。

sentences.en: He said there were a lot of dangerous people out at the time, and it was not safe for her to be wandering the streets alone.
sentences.zh: 他说当时外面有很多危险的人，她一个人在街上游荡很不安全。

sentences.en: Bassett made the drive north towards Carolyn's home in Gwynnville.
sentences.zh: 巴塞特开车向北，前往卡罗琳在格温维尔的家。

sentences.en: When he reached her place, he pulled over just down the street.
sentences.zh: 当到达她家附近时，他把车停在了街头。

sentences.en: At some point, Bassett took a pair of nylon stockings and used them to tie Carolyn's hands behind her back.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，巴塞特拿出一双尼龙袜，把卡罗琳的双手反绑在身后。

sentences.en: He then drove her to Mount Eusley Bypass Road, about five kilometres away.
sentences.zh: 然后他开车把她带到了约五公里外的尤斯利山绕道公路上。

sentences.en: A long, windy road surrounded by thick bush, the most common road driven on by people travelling to and from Sydney.
sentences.zh: 那是一条被茂密灌木丛环绕的长而蜿蜒的道路，是往返悉尼的人们最常走的路线。

sentences.en: Bassett stripped Carolyn, then brutally raped her.
sentences.zh: 巴塞特剥光了卡罗琳的衣服，然后残忍地强奸了她。

sentences.en: During the attack, Bassett grabbed another pair of stockings and a belt and tightened them around Carolyn's throat.
sentences.zh: 袭击过程中，巴塞特抓起另一双长筒袜和一条皮带，紧紧勒住卡罗琳的喉咙。

sentences.en: A hitchhiker walking alone on Mount Eusley Bypass Road walked by Bassett's car around 3.30am.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点30分左右，一名独自走在尤斯利山绕道公路上的搭车客经过了巴塞特的车。

sentences.en: However, he didn't see anything suspect, as the windows were too foggy to see into at the time.
sentences.zh: 然而，他没有看到任何可疑情况，因为当时车窗雾气太重，看不清里面。

sentences.en: After raping Carolyn, Bassett strangled her until she fell unconscious.
sentences.zh: 强奸卡罗琳后，巴塞特勒住她的脖子直到她失去知觉。

sentences.en: He then pulled her from his car and dragged her battered and bruised body out onto the ground.
sentences.zh: 然后他把她从车里拖出来，将她伤痕累累的身体拖到地上。

sentences.en: Bassett picked up a large sandstone rock from the side of the road, stood over Carolyn, lifted the rock high above his head and with violent intensity, brought her back down.
sentences.zh: 巴塞特从路边捡起一块大砂岩，站在卡罗琳上方，将石头高高举过头顶，带着狂暴的力量砸了下去。

sentences.en: When Carolyn didn't return home after her night out on the town, her parents instinctively felt something was wrong and immediately contacted the police.
sentences.zh: 当卡罗琳在城里过夜后没有回家时，她的父母本能地感到不对劲，立即联系了警方。

sentences.en: The police search for Carolyn had already begun when at 6.45am, a couple driving along Mount Eusley Bypass Road on their way
sentences.zh: 警方对卡罗琳的搜寻已经开始，这时在早上6点45分，一对从悉尼回家的夫妇开车经过尤斯利山绕道公路，

sentences.en: home from Sydney spotted what they believed was a dressmaker's dummy.
sentences.zh: 看到了他们认为是裁缝人偶的东西。

sentences.en: When they pulled over to investigate, they realised it was the body of a young woman.
sentences.zh: 当他们停车查看时，意识到那是一名年轻女性的尸体。

sentences.en: It was the third violent murder of a woman that year, all within close proximity of each other.
sentences.zh: 这是那一年发生的第三起针对女性的暴力谋杀案，且都发生在彼此很近的范围内。

sentences.en: People immediately started to wonder if all three murders were linked.
sentences.zh: 人们立即开始怀疑这三起谋杀案是否有关联。

sentences.en: It didn't seem obviously so.
sentences.zh: 看起来并不明显。

sentences.en: The murders of Wilhelmina and Anna were very similar.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜和安娜的谋杀案非常相似。

sentences.en: However, the murder of Carolyn Orphan had several significant differences.
sentences.zh: 然而，卡罗琳·奥尔芬的谋杀案有几个显著的不同之处。

sentences.en: Although Carolyn was strangled like the others, her cause of death was a fractured skull, caused by a large rock that had shattered into two pieces upon impact.
sentences.zh: 虽然卡罗琳也像其他人一样被勒死，但她的死因是颅骨骨折，是由一块在撞击时碎成两半的大石头造成的。

sentences.en: Her murder didn't involve the use of a knife, nor was her body mutilated.
sentences.zh: 她的谋杀案没有使用刀具，尸体也没有被毁坏。

sentences.en: And the most profound difference was the fact that a suspect was identified very quickly for Carolyn's murder.
sentences.zh: 最深刻的区别在于，卡罗琳谋杀案的嫌疑人很快就被确定了。

sentences.en: Alan Bassett had been seen by multiple witnesses leaving the iron workers' club with Carolyn the night of the murder.
sentences.zh: 多名证人看到艾伦·巴塞特在谋杀案当晚与卡罗琳一起离开钢铁工人俱乐部。

sentences.en: The day after the murder, Bassett met with friends in Depto to watch a local game of rugby league.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后的第二天，巴塞特在德普托与朋友们会面，观看当地的橄榄球联赛。

sentences.en: His friends noted that Bassett didn't appear at all interested in the game.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们注意到巴塞特对比赛一点也不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He was just staring and lost in thought.
sentences.zh: 他只是盯着看，陷入了沉思。

sentences.en: This same group of friends were at the iron workers' club the night before when Bassett met Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 这群朋友前一天晚上也在钢铁工人俱乐部，当时巴塞特遇到了卡罗琳。

sentences.en: Later, Bassett's friends saw a photograph of Carolyn in the local news alongside a story detailing her murder.
sentences.zh: 后来，巴塞特的朋友们在当地新闻中看到了卡罗琳的照片，旁边还有关于她被谋杀的报道。

sentences.en: They recognised her as the woman Bassett had gone home with from the iron workers' club.
sentences.zh: 他们认出她就是巴塞特从钢铁工人俱乐部带回家的那个女人。

sentences.en: From there, the overwhelming evidence piled up against Bassett and he couldn't reasonably deny his involvement.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，压倒性的证据堆积在巴塞特身上，他无法合理地否认自己的参与。

sentences.en: His friends, as well as Carolyn's friends, singled him out as the last person seen with her.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们，以及卡罗琳的朋友们，都指出他是最后一个见到她的人。

sentences.en: His car was seen in her street and again on the road where her body was discovered.
sentences.zh: 他的车被发现在她所在的街道上，后来又出现在发现她尸体的路上。

sentences.en: He was arrested and interviewed.
sentences.zh: 他被逮捕并接受了审讯。

sentences.en: At first, Bassett denied any involvement, but upon being shown the nylon stockings used to tie Carolyn's hands behind her back, he paused and said,
sentences.zh: 起初，巴塞特否认有任何参与，但在被出示用于将卡罗琳双手反绑在身后的尼龙袜时，他停顿了一下，说道：

sentences.en: I did do it.
sentences.zh: “是我干的。”

sentences.en: At his murder trial, Bassett calmly told the jury,
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案审判中，巴塞特冷静地告诉陪审团：

sentences.en: It's very hard for me to try and explain things.
sentences.zh: “我很难尝试解释这些事情。”

sentences.en: I didn't realise what I was doing at the time of the crime.
sentences.zh: “在犯罪时，我没有意识到自己在做什么。”

sentences.en: Something must have come over me and I can't really describe things until further tests have been done on me.
sentences.zh: “一定有什么东西控制了我，在对我进行进一步检查之前，我无法真正描述这些事情。”

sentences.en: I certainly did not intend to kill any girl or any person or any such like.
sentences.zh: “我当然无意杀害任何女孩或任何人，或类似的事情。”

sentences.en: I'd ask for a plea of manslaughter, as I don't think it's outright murder.
sentences.zh: “我请求以过失杀人罪判决，因为我不认为这是蓄意谋杀。”

sentences.en: I just ask for your help in my case.
sentences.zh: “我只是请求你们在我的案件中提供帮助。”

sentences.en: The jury deliberated for only 16 minutes before finding Bassett guilty of murder.
sentences.zh: 陪审团仅审议了16分钟，就裁定巴塞特谋杀罪名成立。

sentences.en: The presiding judge commented on Bassett's reckless indifference to human life, and he was sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 主审法官评论了巴塞特对人命的冷漠，他被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: However, following the trial, Bassett was assessed by medical professionals who diagnosed him with schizophrenia.
sentences.zh: 然而，审判后，巴塞特接受了医疗专业人员的评估，被诊断出患有精神分裂症。

sentences.en: He was relocated to a psychiatric hospital to serve his time in a unit for the criminally insane.
sentences.zh: 他被转移到一家精神病院，在一个专门收容刑事精神病患者的病房服刑。

sentences.en: Despite his own father pleading not to release his son back into the community,
sentences.zh: 尽管他自己的父亲恳求不要让他的儿子回到社区，

sentences.en: Alan Bassett only served 29 years of his life sentence, and he was released in 1995.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·巴塞特只服了29年终身监禁，并于1995年获释。

sentences.en: Bassett was an opportunistic, violent rapist and murderer who had preyed on a vulnerable woman at night,
sentences.zh: 巴塞特是一个机会主义的暴力强奸犯和杀人犯，他在夜间猎杀了一名脆弱的女性，

sentences.en: and for that reason, he was considered a person of interest in the murders of Anna Dellenkoa and
sentences.zh: 因此，他被认为是安娜·道林科阿和

sentences.en: Wilhelmina Kruger.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜·克鲁格谋杀案的相关嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Similarities were drawn between all three murders, during which the victims were battered and strangled, and left partially naked in places where they would be easily discovered.
sentences.zh: 这三起谋杀案之间存在相似之处，受害者都被殴打和勒死，并被半裸地丢弃在容易被发现的地方。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina suffered from internal injuries similar to Caroline, consistent with being knocked down on or kneed with great force.
sentences.zh: 威廉敏娜遭受了与卡罗琳类似的内伤，这与被猛力撞倒或膝盖重击一致。

sentences.en: All women suffered distinct injuries to their sexual organs and breasts.
sentences.zh: 所有女性的性器官和乳房都受到了明显的伤害。

sentences.en: Some investigators felt there were similarities to another murder case as well.
sentences.zh: 一些调查人员认为，这些案件与另一起谋杀案也有相似之处。

sentences.en: One year earlier, in early January 1965, the bodies of two 15-year-old friends,
sentences.zh: 一年前，即1965年1月初，两名15岁好友的尸体，

sentences.en: Mary-Anne Schmidt and Christine Scharrock, were discovered partially buried in the deserted, windswept sandhills of Wanda Beach, Cronulla, in the south of Sydney.
sentences.zh: 玛丽-安·施密特和克里斯汀·沙洛克被发现半埋在悉尼南部克罗纳拉旺达海滩荒凉多风的沙丘中。

sentences.en: The two girls had gone missing whilst visiting the beach with Mary-Anne's younger siblings.
sentences.zh: 这两个女孩在与玛丽-安的弟弟妹妹一起去海滩时失踪了。

sentences.en: Mary-Anne and Christine's bodies were found the next day, partially buried in the sand.
sentences.zh: 玛丽-安和克里斯汀的尸体于次日被发现，半埋在沙子里。

sentences.en: Both had suffered from multiple violent stab wounds caused by a knife, amongst other injuries.
sentences.zh: 两人都遭受了多处由刀具造成的暴力刺伤，以及其他伤害。

sentences.en: Their murders came to be known as the Wanda Beach murders, and remain one of the most infamous unsolved Australian murder cases.
sentences.zh: 她们的谋杀案被称为“旺达海滩谋杀案”，至今仍是澳大利亚最臭名昭著的未解谋杀案之一。

sentences.en: We covered the case in detail in Case File episode number one.
sentences.zh: 我们在《案件档案》第一集中详细报道过此案。
